units.source_text: 战争期间，是不会看到穿着如此华丽的长袖和服的女子身影的。

en.t: During the war, one would never see the figure of a woman dressed in such a splendid long-sleeved kimono.

units.source_text: 假如身穿这种盛装出门，半路上定会被人指责，不得不折回家中。

en.t: If she went out in such finery, she would surely be reproached on the way and forced to turn back home.

units.source_text: 她的长袖和服就是这样华美。

en.t: That was how magnificent her long-sleeved kimono was.

units.source_text: 虽然看不见精细的花纹，却能看见绯红腰带上的金丝线闪闪发光，夸张地说，映得四周熠熠生辉。

en.t: Although I could not see the fine patterns, I could see the gold threads on her scarlet sash glittering; to exaggerate, they made everything around them shine.

units.source_text: 年轻貌美的女子端庄地跪坐着，她那白皙的侧脸被浮雕出来，令人怀疑地是不是真正的活人。

en.t: The young and beautiful woman sat kneeling with perfect composure, her pale profile standing out as if carved in relief, making one wonder whether she was truly alive.
